meta.name: Tallow Wharf
meta.note: Campaign map (CMG, mission-framework PLAN 5). World metres, x east, z north (north up), canal along the south edge (z 0-6). Two missions start here: Three Grey Coats (mission.start w1-canal-steps, sections W1 -> W2 -> W3 (crossing, no step) -> W4) and Two-Key Ledger (mission.start w2-arcade, W2 -> W3 -> W4); their mission nodes come from the TGC / TKL slices. The validator spine is linear (W1 -> W2 -> W3 -> W4, no route may skip a section), so TGC crosses W3 with no TGC step there: down the roof fire escape into the east wing, then the strongroom passage and the coal chute (vent unlock) into the coal yard and out the cartway. Lighting (Q2 'Never', Q3, M1; docs/tallow-fixes/LIGHT.md): every fitting is on and working; closed rooms are lit only by the night fittings a real site leaves on; darkness comes from cover, the real gaps between fittings, cut circuits and shot lamps; bands are provisional (light-realism's draft table, A2) until Michael approves the band table. Every value is a declared target, pending V6. D0 (J8 tallow-fixes, 2026-10-26): the wave-0 graph from EGRESS section 1 (way-back bridges, the reading-room stair head, the jetty drop, the long throws, A29, A30, the tank room, the pawn stair, the TGC / TKL splits). D1 (J8 tallow-fixes, 2026-10-26): the graph matches the build: the spawned guard counts per space (A10), the W3 checkpoint on the roof (the bulkhead stair's head), D0's links re-measured from the build, the rooms as built, the vantages at their built pairs, LP's light text (docs/tallow-fixes/val/D1-note.md). Designed exit (G157 9): Three Grey Coats, shed three's candle chest (tgc-4) -> the launch (the W4 extraction box), 19.6 m, 15.1 s at 1.3 m/s: under 2 min. Designed exit (G157 9): Two-Key Ledger, the coal-yard overhear box (tkl-4) -> the launch (the W4 extraction box), forward through the cartway into W4, 45.5 m, 36.4 s at 1.3 m/s (the shutter's hold and crawl included): under 2 min.

W2.name: Arcade lofts
forced_coop: coop_boost + team_rope / team_pull (arcade -> walkway: the first up by the boost at the west pier, the second by the rope there or the pull-up at the east lip)
team_throw (pawn loft -> reading room: a 5.8 m site throw over a 4.9 m gap, forced, M2; pie loft -> clock loft: a standard 2.5 m throw, not yet forced, the plank bridge later, M2 / G403)
team_throw (arcade roof -> counting house roof: a 5.8 m site throw over 4.9 m, forced, M2)

W3.name: Counting house
forced_coop: vent unlock: coop_boost into the coal chute + bolted chute hatch and coal yard door (the only ways into the coal yard, the choke)

W4.name: Wharf sheds
forced_coop: coop_boost (back lane -> shed three, the lane-side clerestory)
